hold.label: Hold under pushes
hold.desc: Palm locked 30 cm up, gravity on, random 0.03 N pushes on each stick every 0.1 s, 0.02 rad start-joint noise. 10 s.

pick.label: Pick, carry and place
pick.desc: chops V4 stage C: the palm descends 5 cm onto a 30 mm cube, lifts it 6 cm, carries it 10 cm to B, lowers it, and the sticks must let go. 10.5 s.

s1_hold.label: Hold under noise
s1_hold.desc: Palm 30 cm up, gravity, 0.1 N pushes every 0.1 s, 0.02 rad start noise, palm wobble up to +-5 deg (2 Hz) and shake up to 10 m/s2 (3 Hz). 10 s.

s2_openclose.label: Open/close on command
s2_openclose.desc: The command moves the grip between open and closed (random goals, speeds and dwells); tips must follow, sticks held. 0.02 N pushes.

pick_oc.label: Pick and place, open/close grip
pick_oc.desc: Palm comes down 5 cm with the grip open (68 mm), closes on a 30 mm cube, lifts it 6 cm, carries it 10 cm to B, lowers it and opens to let go. 10.5 s.

s3_pick15.label: Pick and place, 15° sticks
s3_pick15.desc: Palm comes down 5 cm with the grip open, sticks 15 deg below horizontal, closes on a 30 mm cube, lifts it 6 cm, carries it 10 cm to B, lowers it and opens to let go. 10.5 s.

s3_pick_hard.label: Harder pick: 15° sticks, cube ±1.5 cm / ±17°, 0.02 N pushes
s3_pick_hard.desc: As the 15° pick and place (30 mm cube, 10 cm carry), but the cube starts anywhere within ±1.5 cm and ±17° and random 0.02 N pushes hit each stick every 0.1 s. 10.5 s.

s3_pick25.label: Pick and place, 15° sticks, 25 mm cube
s3_pick25.desc: Palm comes down 5 cm with the grip open, sticks 15 deg below horizontal, closes on a 25 mm cube, lifts it 6 cm, carries it 10 cm to B, lowers it and opens to let go. 10.5 s.

s3_pick25r.label: Pick and place, 25 mm cube, 0.2 rad finger range
s3_pick25r.desc: As the 25 mm pick and place (15° sticks), but the policy may move each finger joint up to 0.2 rad from the grip (was 0.1). 10.5 s.

s4_human.label: Human-style hold: pick and place, 25 mm cube
s4_human.desc: Back of the hand up; thumb, index and middle on the upper stick, thumb base, index base and ring finger on the lower; sticks 20 deg down. Palm comes down 5 cm with the grip open, closes on a 25 mm cube, lifts it 6 cm, carries it 10 cm to B, lowers it and opens. 10.5 s.

entries.label: Scripted grip
entries.desc: No policy: the fingers hold the MuJoCo grip and only the palm moves. The baseline every trained policy must beat.

entries.label: Stage 2: open/close on command
entries.desc: From s1_hold's policy; open closed_v5_mj3_open68mm_g_makis240, closed closed_v5_mj3_sq35_makis240.

entries.label: Stage 2 (new PPO settings): open/close on command
entries.desc: Continued from s2_openclose's best with desired_kl 0.02, entropy 0.005, batch 1792, 3 epochs.

entries.label: Stage 1 at 95%: hold under noise
entries.desc: Continued from s1_hold's best; stops at 95%.

entries.label: Stage 2 (again): open/close on command
entries.desc: From s1_hold95's policy; open closed_v5_mj3_open68mm_g_makis240, closed closed_v5_mj3_sq35_makis240.

entries.label: Stage 3: pick and place
entries.desc: From s2_openclose_v2's best; open/close grip on the pick-and-place path.

entries.label: Stage 3b: pick and place, flatter sticks
entries.desc: From s3_pick's best; sticks 15 deg below horizontal.

entries.label: Stage 3d: harder pick
entries.desc: From s3_pick15's best; cube ±1.5 cm / ±17°, 0.02 N pushes.

entries.label: Stage 3e: pick and place, 25 mm cube
entries.desc: From s3_pick15's best; 25 mm cube, sticks 15 deg.

entries.label: Stage 3f: 25 mm cube, wider finger range
entries.desc: From s3_pick25's best; finger corrections up to 0.2 rad.

grip_labs.label: First: closed_v5_mj
grip_labs.desc: First MuJoCo grip, no finger lag. Older, shorter battery.

grip_labs.label: closed_v5_mj2
grip_labs.desc: Firmer thumb and ring-finger pinch on the lower stick, 0.15 s finger lag. ~5 N on the index finger.

grip_labs.label: closed_v5_mj3
grip_labs.desc: The mj2 pinch x1.5. ~8 N on the index finger.

grip_labs.label: closed_v5_mj4 (10 N)
grip_labs.desc: Pinch x2 plus a light upper-stick pinch: ~10 N on the index finger.

grip_labs.label: Open: 46mm_extend (from closed_v5_mj4)
grip_labs.desc: Tips 17.5 -> 45.5 mm, back to 35.2 mm when closed again.

grip_labs.label: Open: 127mm_extend (from closed_v5_mj2)
grip_labs.desc: Tips 22.9 -> 127.1 mm, back to 35.3 mm when closed again.

grip_labs.label: Open: 61mm_rand25 (from closed_v5_mj3)
grip_labs.desc: Tips 15.8 -> 61.2 mm, back to 34.4 mm when closed again.
